timezone.title: This device can't tell Phare what day it is
timezone.body: Phare works out which day — and so which month — a transaction belongs to using your household's time zone. This device's date formatting ignores the time zone it's given, so every date would be a guess.
timezone.consequence: Rather than book your money into the wrong month without telling you, Phare stops here.
timezone.whatToDo: Please send this screen to support@phare.money along with your device model and OS version.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use the same email and password as the website.
signIn.failed: That email and password didn't match. Please check them and try again.
signIn.offline: Couldn't reach Phare. Check your connection and try again.
signIn.forgotHint: Forgot your password? Reset it on phare.money, then sign in here.

review.title: Your monthly review
review.empty: Your first review will appear here once Phare has a full month of your household's activity.
review.locked: The rest of this letter isn't part of your current plan.
review.signedOut: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

timeline.title: Cash Timeline
timeline.noChequing: Phare needs a chequing account before it can show your timeline. You can add one on phare.money.

noAnchor.title: To show your timeline, Phare needs one real number: your chequing balance on a date you know.
noAnchor.body: Set your chequing account's opening balance on phare.money, and everything else follows from it.

header.noDip: No upcoming pay found, so there's no dip to show. Add your income on phare.money.
header.lowestBeforePay: Lowest point before your next pay ({payday}):
header.dipsBelowZeroBeforePay: You dip below zero before your next pay ({payday}):

list.empty: Nothing on the books this month.
list.balancesBegin: Balances begin {date} — the date of your first anchor.
list.untilNextPay: Next month, up to your pay on {payday}

errors.network: Couldn't reach Phare. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Runtime checks for this device. Nothing here is user-facing.
diagnostics.nbspExpected: fr-CA is correct only if both separators are U+00A0
diagnostics.streamProbeExplain: Calls /api/review-stream?stream=0 to prove React Native's fetch can read a non-streamed body. This one call spends Anthropic tokens.

account.title: Account
account.signOutFailed: Couldn't sign out. You're still signed in on this device. Check your connection and try again.

cards.title: Room on your cards
cards.noCards: No credit cards set up yet. You can add them on phare.money.

entry.title: Add an expense
entry.noAccounts: There's no chequing account or credit card to add this to. You can add one on phare.money.

problems.dateInvalid: Enter a real date, written as YYYY-MM-DD.
problems.descriptionTooLong: That description is too long. Keep it to {max} characters.
problems.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above zero, like 12.50.

errors.invalidAmount: Phare couldn't accept that amount. Enter an amount above zero, with at most two decimals.
errors.invalidDate: Phare couldn't accept that date. Enter a real date, written as YYYY-MM-DD.
errors.descriptionTooLong: That description is too long. Keep it to {max} characters.
errors.categoryNotFound: That category isn't available any more. Close this screen and open it again.
errors.accountNotFound: That account isn't available any more. Close this screen and open it again.
errors.payloadTooLarge: That entry is too large to save.
errors.noChequing: Phare needs a chequing account first. You can add one on phare.money.
errors.saveFailed: Phare couldn't save this expense, and nothing was recorded. Please try again.

terms.updated: Our terms were updated. Review and accept them on phare.money, then sign in again.

form.title: Enter your numbers
form.subtitle: Add what you know — two or three lines is enough to start. You can add the rest any time.
form.incomeHint: Enter what lands in your bank account each pay, then pick how often. Phare works out the monthly figure.
form.expenseHint: Enter what you pay each time, then pick how often. Start with the big ones.
form.combinedIncome: Combined household income for the year (optional)
form.combinedIncomeHint: Used only to check that your income lines add up.

problems.noIncome: Add at least one income line.
problems.labelMissing: The marked line has an amount but no name. Name it, or clear the amount.
problems.amountInvalid: The marked line's amount couldn't be read. Enter an amount above zero, like 1250.50.
problems.statedInvalid: The combined income couldn't be read. Enter a number, or leave it blank.

plausibility.title: Double-check your income
plausibility.incomeVsStated: You mentioned a combined income around {stated} a year, but your lines add up to about {computed} a year. Does that look right?
plausibility.deficitNotFinanced: Your plan shows a shortfall of {deficit} each month with no credit line or debt payment to explain it. If your income is understated, correct it now.

accounts.title: Your accounts
accounts.subtitle: How many credit cards should Phare include? Your chequing account is set up automatically.
accounts.openingBalance: What's in your chequing account today?
accounts.openingBalanceHint: Optional — but it's the one number your timeline is built on. You can add it later on phare.money.
accounts.openingBalanceInvalid: That balance couldn't be read. Enter a number like 1250.00, or leave it blank.

plan.reviewError: Your plan is saved. Your first review couldn't be written just now.
plan.reviewTooLarge: Your plan is saved. The written review was skipped because there was more detail than one letter can cover.
plan.reviewUnavailableForSave: Your first review couldn't be written, but your plan is saved.
plan.saveError: Phare built your plan but couldn't save it. Nothing was recorded. Try saving again.

needsConfirmation.title: You already have data in Phare
needsConfirmation.body: Phare found data from an earlier plan. Replacing it can only be done on phare.money for now. Nothing was changed.

payDates.title: When do these get paid?
payDates.subtitle: Add a real date for each so it shows up on the right days. You can skip any of them and set them later on phare.money.
payDates.shortMonthNote: 30th or 31st? In shorter months it lands on the last day instead.
payDates.confirmSkip: Some items still have no date. They won't appear in your month view until they do.
payDates.skipNote: Anything left without a date stays flagged, and you can add it later on phare.money.

error.tooFar: That's more than {days} days away — the next payment should be sooner.
error.same: The two days must be different.
error.date: Enter a real date, written as YYYY-MM-DD.
error.cadence: This one can't be dated here. You can set it on phare.money.

done.title: Your plan is ready
done.anchorFailed: Your plan is saved, but your chequing balance wasn't. You can set it on phare.money.

errors.payloadTooLarge: That's more detail than Phare can plan from in one pass. Remove a few lines and try again.
errors.aiUnavailable: Phare couldn't reach its planning service just now. Your numbers are still here — try again in a few minutes.
errors.rateLimited: That was a lot of attempts in a short time. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.notAuthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.onboardingQuotaExhausted: Your household has used all of this month's plan builds. More are available on {date}.
errors.planFailed: Phare couldn't build your plan. Please try again.

deletion.title: Delete your account
deletion.selfBody: Your login is removed and your name is taken off this household. The household itself, and every transaction recorded against you, stays with the people who remain.
deletion.soleMemberBody: You are the only person with an account here, so deleting your account deletes this household and everything in it.
deletion.allPendingBody: Nobody else has ever signed in to this household, so there is no one to hand it to. Deleting your account deletes the household and everything in it.
deletion.exportFirstBody: This is your only chance. Once the deletion runs, none of it can be recovered.
deletion.exportFailed: Couldn't build the export. Please try again.
deletion.noUndo: There is no undo and no grace period. This happens immediately and permanently.
deletion.typeYourEmail: Type your email address to confirm:
deletion.typeHouseholdName: Type your household's name to confirm:
deletion.hatchAcknowledge: I understand that nobody else can take over this household, and that deleting my account will delete it for everyone.
deletion.blockedTitle: You can't delete your account yet
deletion.blockedPromoteBody: You are the only owner, and {names} still uses this household. Make them an owner, then delete your account.
deletion.blockedNoPathBody: Another member still has access, but their role couldn't be read, so ownership can't be handed over safely. Please contact support@phare.money before deleting.
deletion.promoteFailed: Couldn't make them an owner. Please try again.
deletion.doneBody: You've been signed out on this device.
deletion.partialSelfBody: Your access has been removed and your household data is no longer linked to you. Final removal of your login is still in progress.
deletion.partialHouseholdBody: Phare recorded where the deletion stopped. If you can still sign in, open this screen and try again.

errors.confirmationMismatch: What you typed doesn't match. Type it exactly as shown.
errors.promoteFirst: You're the only owner. Make another member an owner first.
errors.blockedNoPath: Ownership can't be handed over safely yet. Please contact support@phare.money.
errors.verdictChanged: Your household changed since this screen opened. Close it and open it again.
errors.paymentServiceFailed: A payment service didn't respond, so nothing has been deleted. Please try again, or contact support@phare.money.
errors.failed: Couldn't complete the deletion. Please try again.
